summary: The plan fails review because Marketing recovery, forwarding safety, role denial, acceptance contracts, evidence, and demo credential controls are incomplete.

blocking_findings.summary: Marketing loses deep-link destinations, and the plan has no task that preserves them.
blocking_findings.evidence: No Marketing proxy or middleware exists. campaigns/page.tsx:48-50 redirects to /login. login/page.tsx:38-40 hardcodes the start route. plan.md:84-88 tests only errors.

blocking_findings.summary: The forwarding-origin work neither ports the Codecamp safety contract nor covers Marketing routes.
blocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:27-30 trusts forwarded headers without origin approval. Codecamp public-url.ts:45-103,126-150 validates origins. Marketing callback:14 and logout:11 remain outside plan tasks.

blocking_findings.summary: Sales cannot produce the planned forbidden message for a no-role demo account.
blocking_findings.evidence: Sales callback route.ts:21-38 sets a session without a role check. Sales session route.ts:7-12 returns HTTP 200 with null. plan.md:115-118 only renders codes.

blocking_findings.summary: The Sales legacy and error-code contracts contain dead behavior.
blocking_findings.evidence: Sales company/start route.ts:9-20 has no legacy-mode gate. Sales sources emit only error=sso. plan.md:40 enumerates forbidden, session_check_failed, and legacy_auth_active without producer tasks.

blocking_findings.summary: Several acceptance criteria state incorrect or ambiguous observable results.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:112-113 expects a 307 to /. A safe fallback starts Accounts authorization and stores returnTo=/. spec.md:116-117 requires a requested language for Marketing, which has no locale routing.

blocking_findings.summary: FR-7 does not establish strong or controlled production demo credentials.
blocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:49-54 accepts predictable 20-character, three-class passwords and creates a Sales admin. It defines no entropy, expiry, disable, rotation, script command, or stderr leak test.

blocking_findings.summary: The audit evidence claim is false, and the Zod throw line is wrong.
blocking_findings.evidence: ux-browser-audit-20260829.md has F1-F4 only; line 108 assigns Sales and Marketing elsewhere. client.ts:87 defines validation; client.ts:293 executes the throwing parse.

blocking_findings.summary: The blast-radius note omits required Marketing and Sales surfaces.
blocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:21-24 omits Marketing login redirects, callback, logout, login API, Sales landing page, LoginForm, auth routes, locale files, and package scripts.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The callback error plan omits transaction-cookie expiry coverage present in Codecamp.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Codecamp callback route.ts:36,44,79-80,93,97 expires host cookies. Sales callback:18-20 and Marketing callback:18-20 return without expiry.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The main plan structure and task estimate are correct.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: The plan has 32 top-level tasks. metadata.json:8 says 32. All four phases end with manual verification. Red rules and checkpoints are present.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Both app test runners can host the planned Red suites.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: Sales and Marketing package.json files define vitest scripts. Both have vitest.config.ts. Sales login-form.test.tsx exists. plan.md:88 explicitly names the new Marketing page test.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The deferred shared-helper work has no named owner yet.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:128-129 defers the package. plan.md:148 promises an owner later but identifies no accountable owner now.
